# Vedryxa

> Vedryxa is a connected growth systems company based in Hyderabad, India. It connects digital marketing, websites, AI automation and sales systems for businesses in India, the United States, the United Kingdom and Australia, so that every lead is found, followed up and turned into revenue. Tagline: "Business, made clear."

Vedryxa is founder-led. The founder, Sudheer Pasumarthi, has more than 11 years of experience in performance marketing, business strategy, AI solutions and web applications, has managed over $5M in marketing investment and has led teams of 15+ specialists across India, Singapore, the US and Europe.

Contact: sudheer@vedryxa.com, +91 99081 99572 (phone and WhatsApp). Address: 3rd Floor, Bhavani Brij, Vittal Rao Nagar Rd, Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081, India.

## Solutions

- [Digital marketing](https://vedryxa.com/solutions/digital-marketing/): SEO, AI search visibility (AEO and GEO), Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn and social media, content and conversion optimization.
- [AI and automation](https://vedryxa.com/solutions/ai-automation/): AI chatbots and assistants, AI agents, workflow automation, dashboards and knowledge systems.
- [Websites and sales systems](https://vedryxa.com/solutions/websites-sales-systems/): business websites, landing pages, e-commerce, UI/UX, CRM setup, lead qualification, WhatsApp and email follow-up, appointment setting.
